title: Cancellation during the loyalty period — settlement and what happens to your web address
body:
If you ordered a **custom web address** from us for your website, it comes with a loyalty period: when you placed the order, you committed to keeping your subscription for a set length of time (you saw this on the Overview screen before you paid). During the loyalty period, cancellation therefore involves a **settlement** — this screen calculates it, item by item, before you finalise anything.

## How do I get here?

At the bottom of the **Modules** tab, in the „Cancel subscription” box, tap the **„Cancel subscription…”** button. If you still have a running loyalty period, the system won't ask the usual confirmation but will bring you to this settlement page instead. If you have no loyalty period, everything works as before: after confirmation, the cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you have already paid for.

![Screenshot: the cancellation settlement page on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## What do I see on the page?

- **Loyalty bar:** the name of your web address, and how much of the committed months has passed and how much is left — with a progress indicator.
- **Itemised settlement:** the fee for the remaining months at the committed minimum rate (this is the penalty — always payable), and on a separate line the purchase price of the web address, which is only included if you also take the web address with you.
- **„I'll take the web address too” checkbox:** if you tick it, the purchase price line, the total, the label on the red button, and the consequence text all update together — you always see exactly what you would pay.
- **Consequence bar:** it states what happens to the web address (you take it → it's yours after payment; you don't → it stays with us), and until when your website will remain available.

## How do I complete the cancellation?

With the red **„Settlement and cancellation”** button — the total is always shown next to the label, so there are no surprises. After that:

1. We record the settlement and **send the payment link by email**.
2. Your website remains available until the end of the period you have already paid for, after which it is taken down.
3. If you take the web address with you: ownership transfers **after the full settlement has been paid in full** (Terms and Conditions, point 9) — we'll send the steps by email afterwards. If you don't take it, the web address stays with us.

## I've changed my mind

- On the settlement page, the **„Don't cancel — go back”** button leaves everything unchanged — nothing is recorded, and your subscription and web address continue as before.
- If you have already recorded the cancellation but **have not yet paid** the payment link, you can step back on the Modules tab with the **„I changed my mind — continue”** button: we delete the settlement and your subscription continues.
- If you have already paid the settlement, please write to us — at that point it's no longer a matter of a button, but of arranging things together.

## How much is the penalty?

The number of remaining months × the committed monthly minimum. If you received the web address free of charge (alongside a larger package), the monthly minimum was fixed at the time of ordering, and later price changes do not affect it. If you paid an annual fee for the web address, the commitment there is keeping the subscription itself — in that case the penalty is based on the fee of your current monthly package. The exact amount is always shown on this screen, before payment.
